column1: # Loom (loomkor korean.trs, VGA talkie), U preset: 2 bpp, LOOMKO.MAP's default (true-colour) preset.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# Output names follow the source font, <font><px>[variant].SVF (SCUMM_FONTS.md, "Face file names"); a name another
# plan also writes (the same font, size, cell and ascent) comes out byte for byte the same, one shared file.
# Both charsets: NanumGothic-Bold. Size and ascent follow the charset's cell (cs1 16x16 -> 15/14,
# cs2 18x18 -> 16/15, as mkfont.py --fit-cell picks over the korean.trs text).
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
